**Solution:**

A point is closer to 4 than to 0 when its distance to 4 is less than its distance to 0.

**Setting up the inequality:**

|x − 4| < |x − 0|

|x − 4| < |x|

**Solving:**

Square both sides (both sides are non-negative):

(x − 4)² < x²

x² − 8x + 16 < x²

−8x + 16 < 0

16 < 8x

x > 2

**Identifying the favorable segment:**

The point must satisfy both x > 2 **and** 0 ≤ x ≤ 5.

So the favorable region is **2 < x ≤ 5**, which has length **3**.

**Calculating the probability:**

$$P = \frac{3}{5} = 0.6$$

**The probability is 0.6.**
